scope: Reanalysis of already generated, immutable RGB predictions; no new inference and no GPU use.

cohorts.name: Fresh C frozen full cohort
cohorts.role: Cohort heterogeneity analysis; includes 20 UIDs appearing in the earlier 26-object diagnostic cohort and is not labeled wholly independent.

cohorts.name: Fresh C diagnostic-UID-excluded subset
cohorts.role: UID-disjoint reanalysis after excluding every Fresh C UID found in the 26-object diagnostic set; this exclusion is based only on the already frozen UID lists.

cohorts.name: Fresh B frozen holdout
cohorts.role: Independent confirmation cohort; frozen UID list is disjoint from the 26-object diagnostic set and the Fresh C cohort.

identity_requirements: Match UID, object index, seed policy, six target-view IDs/order, checkpoint SHA-256, runner SHA-256, config SHA-256, and input tensor hashes.
Verify each selected prediction PNG against its run output SHA-256 manifest before metric computation.
Keep Fresh C primary and addendum files separated by condition and provenance; never combine their residual logs or row tables without UID and input-hash joins.
Fresh B and Fresh C remain separate cohorts; report no pooled effect across cohorts.

primary.name: fg_ciede2000_rgb
primary.definition: For each of six views, compute mean CIEDE2000 over the GT foreground mask (uint8 mask > 127), then average the six view means equally, matching the frozen R1 diagnostic metric implementation. Use saved 8-bit prediction RGB and a reconstructed target panel serialized with torchvision save_image round-to-nearest after the frozen loader's white-background composite, bicubic antialiased resize to 256, unique6 ordering, and reverse-view rotations of target slots 1 and 3 where required.

primary.name: fg_psnr_recorded
primary.definition: Frozen per-object metric from the campaign CSV produced from the float prediction before 8-bit PNG serialization.

primary.name: fg_lpips_recorded
primary.definition: Frozen per-object AlexNet LPIPS from the campaign CSV, same cohort and UID-matched condition rows.

primary.name: gt_relative_laplacian_error_rgb
primary.definition: Mean absolute difference between 3x3 cross-Laplacian responses of prediction and GT RGB channels in [0,1], computed view-wise with reflect padding and restricted to the 1-pixel-eroded resized GT alpha mask. This is a GT-relative high-frequency error, not raw high-frequency energy.

statistics.inferential_unit: object UID; one paired difference per object
statistics.bootstrap: 10,000 object-level paired percentile bootstrap resamples; fixed seed 20261008; two-sided 95% interval
report: standardized paired effect (Cohen dz where SD is nonzero)
wins, losses, ties and favorable-object fraction
all object-level deltas and failed cases
statistics.heterogeneity: Use frozen GT-only texture fields and previously defined Fresh B quartile assignment/cut points where the manifest provides them; additionally report continuous Spearman associations. Do not derive groups from generated outputs or tune thresholds after viewing deltas.

schedule_and_cap_audit.GFL_effective: deep=1.25, middle=1.25, shallow=min(1.25, 0.8)=0.8 for all 50 steps
schedule_and_cap_audit.LLH_requested: stage partition over step/49: steps 0-16 deep/middle=1.25, shallow=0.5; steps 17-32 same; steps 33-49 deep/middle=2.5, shallow=0.75
schedule_and_cap_audit.LLH_effective: same as requested for all layers under caps deep=3.0, middle=3.5, shallow=0.8
schedule_and_cap_audit.interpretation: LLH and GFL are not equal-dose controls. Residual logs will be summarized descriptively by layer and step; these summaries will not be used as causal evidence by themselves.

prohibitions: No result-driven object selection or subgroup threshold changes.
No RGB recoloring, GT-based postprocessing, or target-view GT conditioning.
No cross-cohort pooled estimate and no Python 3.10/3.13 metric mixing.
